maintenance_receipts.calculation_source:
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt

p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(p.read_text())
progress=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-training-v4/progress/step500-runtime.json')
runtime=json.loads(progress.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'].endswith('qwen3-8-27b-training'):
        session.pop('session_limit_hours',None)
        session.update(status='live_draft_access_blocked_phase_unknown',
                       script_wall_cap_seconds=14400, platform_session_limit_hours=12,
                       last_verified_progress_runtime_file=str(progress),
                       last_verified_script_wall_seconds=runtime['wall_seconds'],
                       last_verified_phase=runtime['phase'],last_verified_phase_step=runtime['phase_step'],
                       script_hours_lower_bound=runtime['wall_seconds']/3600,
                       release_note='Training script wall cap does not establish interactive allocation release. No final runtime or allocation end is accessible.')
    if session['kernel'].endswith('staged-sft-dice-serial') and session['version']==1:
        path=Path('results/kaggle/staged-sft-serial-failure-v1/makemarketbench-staged-sft-dice-serial.log')
        last=max(item['time'] for item in json.loads(path.read_text()))
        session.update(last_downloaded_log_seconds=last,hours=last/3600,
                       hours_basis='Last downloaded log timestamp only, not exact billed allocation duration.')
    path=Path(session.get('runtime_file','missing'))
    if path.is_file():
        runtime_record=json.loads(path.read_text())
        for source,target in [('execution_started_at','script_started_at'),('execution_finished_at','script_finished_at')]:
            if source in runtime_record:session[target]=runtime_record[source]
ledger.setdefault('maintenance_receipts',[]).append({'recorded_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'distinguish script limits, live progress and unknown allocation release'}),
    'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text()})
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume.json');r=json.loads(p.read_text())
r['version']=int(re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)',r['push']['output']).group(1))
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
